common_symptoms: fever, rash, headache, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, muscle pain, joint pain, encephalitis
complications: severe symptoms, such as petechiae, neurological complications
epidemiology: rare, more common in certain regions of the United States
risk_factors: exposure to tick bites, outdoor activities in endemic areas
preventive_measures: tick bite prevention, use of insect repellent, wearing protective clothing
diagnosis_challenges: nonspecific symptoms, lack of early biomarkers
